title: Skywalker’s Destiny Beckons
front_description: While on Naboo, Anakin is caught in the grip of a soul-wrenching dream. Although his romantic feelings for Padmé are nothing less than intoxicating, the young Jedi is greatly troubled by the ongoing plight of his beloved mother, still a slave (he believes) on the planet Tatooine. The terrible nightmare has convinced Anakin that he must go to her at once, and Padmé agrees to go with him.
back_description: Hayden Christiensen and Natalie Portman clown around on the Episode II set.
